parameters.query:
=WITH payload AS (SELECT '{{$json.body_sql}}'::jsonb AS body),
decision_check AS (
  SELECT (body->>'decision') AS decision,
         ((body->>'decision') IN ('approved','rejected','revision_requested')) AS valid_decision
  FROM payload
), approval_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO content_approvals (job_id, approval_stage, decision, reviewer_id, reviewer_notes)
  SELECT NULLIF(body->>'job_id','')::uuid, 'plan', decision,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(body->>'reviewer_id',''), 'andy'),
         NULLIF(body->>'reviewer_notes','')
  FROM payload, decision_check
  WHERE valid_decision
  RETURNING job_id, decision
), job_update AS (
  UPDATE content_jobs
  SET status = CASE
    WHEN 'plan'='analysis' AND (SELECT decision FROM approval_insert)='approved' THEN 'waiting_for_plan_approval'::job_status
    WHEN 'plan'='plan' AND (SELECT decision FROM approval_insert)='approved' THEN 'generating_outputs'::job_status
    ELSE status
  END,
  updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = (SELECT job_id FROM approval_insert)
  RETURNING id, status
), event_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO content_events (job_id,event_type,message,metadata)
  SELECT job_id, 'approval_recorded', 'Approval recorded for plan', jsonb_build_object('stage','plan','decision',decision)
  FROM approval_insert
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT valid_decision FROM decision_check), false) AS valid_decision,
  (SELECT job_id::text FROM approval_insert) AS job_id,
  (SELECT decision FROM approval_insert) AS decision,
  (SELECT status::text FROM job_update) AS status;
